name: Duruelo de la Sierra (Spain)
description: Vertical tricolour of blue, white and green, the white charged with the crowned municipal arms of Duruelo de la Sierra (a tree on white above waves and a bridge).
history: Municipal flag of Duruelo de la Sierra; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Duruelo de la Sierra arms — tree on white above waves and bridge
cap of the crown of the arms
